page.overview:
What is Tumi?

Tumi is a country located in the South Blue. It was conquered by the Revolutionary Army around twelve years ago.

Tumi appears to feature at least one town, with a large tower in the center. Said tower was destroyed by Bartholomew Kuma, implying it was a stronghold of sorts for the local rulers.

Fifteen years ago, Tumi fell into an uprising by its local population, which was supported by the Revolutionary Army. However, after three years of civil war, the rebels started getting outmatched by the local military force.

Kuma, who at the time was in the East Blue helping refugees from the Gray Terminal, listened to an aid request coming from Tumi and teleported himself to the island as quickly as possible. Kuma's arrival was enough to tilt the war in favor of the rebels, with its population celebrating their victory the following day and the Marines taking notice of another fallen country.
